description.en: Loads a camera motion file (a scripted camera path/animation, .xv) and returns its handle.
Internal name for the camera instance.
Path to the camera file, e.g. "data/chr/motion/waza/hqev010100.pck|hqev010100_cam.xv".

example.code:
// Load a scripted camera path for a technique cutscene
local hCamera = CMND_LOAD_CAMERA("\x0083J\x0083\x0081\x0083\x0089", "data/chr/motion/waza/hqev010100.pck|hqev010100_cam.xv");
